title: Plan phase output
description: An ordered set of independently verifiable tasks. The tasks array is the collection the implement phase fans out over, so it stays flat: grouping is expressed by group id rather than by nesting, because fan-out selects exactly one array.

documentPath.description: The full plan in the repository, where per-task detail lives.

groups.description: Workstreams. Tasks reference one by id. Grouping survives into the portal, where members are drawn inside their parent.

parallelizable.description: Whether this group's tasks may run concurrently. v1 executes sequentially regardless; this records intent for when it does not.

tasks.description: One element becomes one implement member phase, each running its own loop.

successCriteria.description: Conditions for the plan as a whole, distinct from per-task verification.
